body.objective: Extend the axial open-interval pilot into a low/compact/high-frequency and general-angular channel theorem.
body.stop_condition: Join an exact low-frequency analysis, validated compact-frequency cover and analytic high-frequency estimate; then prove the strongest uniform ell>=2 statement supported by the data, with every excluded threshold and pole set explicit.
body.forbid: no finite numerical scan called all-frequency or all-ell proof; no omega=0 limit without a separate resonant analysis; no scattering completeness beyond the proved channel map
body.resource_hint: Use analytic asymptotics to close infinite frequency and angular tails; validated numerics cover only compact boxes.
